data.one_liner: Material style segmented control widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single‑purpose segmented control that follows Material design. Allows custom colors, text styles, border radius, and disabling of individual segments. Emits the tapped index via a callback.
use_when: You need a Material‑styled segmented control UI component.
You want easy customization of colors, borders, and disabled segments.
avoid_when: You require iOS‑style Cupertino segmented control.
You need a full widget library rather than a single control.
strengths: Simple API and easy to drop into existing code.
Highly customizable appearance and disabled‑segment support.
weaknesses: Only provides a segmented control, no other UI components.
Limited animation or advanced interaction features.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a broader collection of Material widgets, including similar controls, reducing the need for a dedicated package.
